hooks.command: f=$(php -r '$x=json_decode(stream_get_contents(STDIN),true);echo $x["tool_input"]["file_path"]??$x["tool_response"]["filePath"]??"";'); case "$f" in *.php) r=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -x "$r/vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer" ] && [ -f "$r/.php-cs-fixer.dist.php" ]; then case "$f" in "$r"/src/*|"$r"/tests/*) "$r/vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer" fix "$f" --config="$r/.php-cs-fixer.dist.php" --quiet 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; fi;; esac
